topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Mornin', Neighbor. I reckon you've heard by now, but young Eli, he's been pulled from his field and sent off to help the blacksmith. It's not that he lacked the might or the grace for our plow, mind you. His hands, they were strong and his spirit, unyielding. But the forge, they say, needs more than just any pair of hands. I should've spoken for him, should've told the lord just what his work means to us all. But the soil keeps on, even when the man changes. Maybe the blacksmith can teach him something we couldn't. I'll miss his whistle echoing across the plots, but the harvests, they’ll still need tending. Hope you're well, with the sun on your back and the soil soft beneath your feet.
